One loss is a trade. Three in a row is REVENGE. 🧠

The -1R didn't hurt your account. The 3 trades you took to win it back did. Revenge trading turns a normal red day into a disaster.

1️⃣ Max 2 losses a day
2️⃣ After the stop: walk away
3️⃣ Never double the size
